<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="SyntheticDefinitions" name="SyntheticOnly" namespace="urn:synthetic:query-dmn-example">
<inputData id="i_lookup_outcome" name="lookup_outcome"><variable name="lookup_outcome" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_scene_status" name="scene_status"><variable name="scene_status" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_availability_fact" name="availability_fact"><variable name="availability_fact" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_fact_order_id" name="fact_order_id"><variable name="fact_order_id" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_queried_order_id" name="queried_order_id"><variable name="queried_order_id" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_feature_state" name="feature_state"><variable name="feature_state" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_conclusions" name="conclusions"><variable name="conclusions" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_focal_conclusion" name="focal_conclusion"><variable name="focal_conclusion" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_acceptance_status" name="acceptance_status"><variable name="acceptance_status" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_strategy" name="strategy"><variable name="strategy" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<inputData id="i_compensation_status" name="compensation_status"><variable name="compensation_status" typeRef="Any"/></inputData>
<decision id="validate_scene" name="validate_scene"><variable name="validate_scene" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_lookup_outcome"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_validate_scene" hitPolicy="UNIQUE"><input id="x1"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>lookup_outcome</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x2" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="validate_scene_r1"><inputEntry id="x3"><text>"FOUND"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x4"><text>"VALID"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="validate_scene_r2"><inputEntry id="x5"><text>"NOT_FOUND"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x6"><text>"NOT_ESTABLISHED"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="acceptance" name="acceptance"><variable name="acceptance" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_scene_status"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_acceptance" hitPolicy="UNIQUE"><input id="x7"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>scene_status</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x8" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="acceptance_r1"><inputEntry id="x9"><text>"VALID"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x10"><text>"ACCEPT"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="acceptance_r2"><inputEntry id="x11"><text>"NOT_ESTABLISHED"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x12"><text>"MANUAL_REVIEW"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="compensation_limit" name="compensation_limit"><variable name="compensation_limit" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_scene_status"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_compensation_limit" hitPolicy="UNIQUE"><input id="x13"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>scene_status</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x14" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="compensation_limit_r1"><inputEntry id="x15"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x16"><text>"NO_COMPENSATION_AUTHORIZED"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="feature" name="feature"><variable name="feature" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_availability_fact"/></informationRequirement><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_fact_order_id"/></informationRequirement><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_queried_order_id"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_feature" hitPolicy="UNIQUE"><input id="x17"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>fact_order_id = queried_order_id</text></inputExpression></input><input id="x18"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>availability_fact</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x19" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="feature_r1"><inputEntry id="x20"><text>true</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x21"><text>"ABSENT"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x22"><text>"SATISFIED"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="feature_r2"><inputEntry id="x23"><text>true</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x24"><text>"PRESENT"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x25"><text>"NOT_SATISFIED"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="feature_r3"><inputEntry id="x26"><text>true</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x27"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x28"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="feature_r4"><inputEntry id="x29"><text>false</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x30"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x31"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="reality" name="reality"><variable name="reality" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_feature_state"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_reality" hitPolicy="COLLECT"><input id="x32"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>feature_state</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x33" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="reality_r1"><inputEntry id="x34"><text>"SATISFIED"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x35"><text>"CONFIRMED_ABSENT"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="reality_r2"><inputEntry id="x36"><text>"NOT_SATISFIED"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x37"><text>"CONFIRMED_PRESENT"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="reality_r3"><inputEntry id="x38"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x39"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="reality_priority" name="reality_priority"><variable name="reality_priority" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_conclusions"/></informationRequirement><literalExpression><text>if list contains(conclusions, "UNKNOWN") then "UNKNOWN" else if list contains(conclusions, "CONFIRMED_ABSENT") then "CONFIRMED_ABSENT" else if list contains(conclusions, "CONFIRMED_PRESENT") then "CONFIRMED_PRESENT" else "UNKNOWN"</text></literalExpression></decision>
<decision id="disposition" name="disposition"><variable name="disposition" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_focal_conclusion"/></informationRequirement><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_acceptance_status"/></informationRequirement><decisionTable id="t_disposition" hitPolicy="FIRST"><input id="x40"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>acceptance_status</text></inputExpression></input><input id="x41"><inputExpression typeRef="Any"><text>focal_conclusion</text></inputExpression></input><output id="x42" name="result" typeRef="Any"/><rule id="disposition_r1"><inputEntry id="x43"><text>"MANUAL_REVIEW"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x44"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x45"><text>"MANUAL_REVIEW"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="disposition_r2"><inputEntry id="x46"><text>-</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x47"><text>"UNKNOWN"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x48"><text>"MANUAL_REVIEW"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="disposition_r3"><inputEntry id="x49"><text>"ACCEPT"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x50"><text>"CONFIRMED_ABSENT"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x51"><text>"CHECK_RECOVERY_OPTIONS"</text></outputEntry></rule><rule id="disposition_r4"><inputEntry id="x52"><text>"ACCEPT"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="x53"><text>"CONFIRMED_PRESENT"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="x54"><text>"EXPLAIN_CONFIRMED_STATE"</text></outputEntry></rule></decisionTable></decision>
<decision id="action_advice" name="action_advice"><variable name="action_advice" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_strategy"/></informationRequirement><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_compensation_status"/></informationRequirement><literalExpression><text>if strategy = "CHECK_RECOVERY_OPTIONS" then [{recommendation_type:"REVIEW_OPTIONS", capability_id:"synthetic.unbound_action", binding_status:"GAP", execution_mode:"ADVISORY_ONLY", compensation_status:compensation_status}] else []</text></literalExpression></decision>
<decision id="ticket_advice" name="ticket_advice"><variable name="ticket_advice" typeRef="Any"/><informationRequirement><requiredInput href="#i_strategy"/></informationRequirement><literalExpression><text>[{recommendation_type:if strategy = "MANUAL_REVIEW" then "REFER_TO_HUMAN" else "ADD_REVIEW_NOTE", target:"SYNTHETIC_SECOND_LINE_TICKET", binding_status:"GAP", execution_mode:"ADVISORY_ONLY"}]</text></literalExpression></decision>
</definitions>
